params.tags: A light, upbeat but calm instrumental chiptune and soft electronic track in D major. Warm square-wave lead with short melodic phrases, gentle arpeggiated pulse synths, a round soft synth bass and light, tidy drum machine kicks and rimshots. Friendly and curious, like a tech explainer bed: clean, uncluttered mix that sits under on-screen text, soft highs, no harsh noise. Clear short intro, steady middle, and a clean resolved ending on the tonic. No vocals.
params.lyrics:
[Intro - soft arpeggio alone]

[Verse - bass and light drums enter]

[Build - lead melody, a little brighter]

[Chorus - fullest, still calm]

[Bridge - drums drop back, pads and arpeggio]

[Chorus - lead returns]

[Outro - arpeggio alone, resolves and ends cleanly]
params.title: inkling explainer bed
